requirements.description: Coin Pusher drops a coin onto a shelf on the shared exactly-once settlement core. The shelf holds a random pile of earlier coins and the dropped coin advances the pile by a random push; when the filled height reaches the tipping threshold of twelve the overflowing coins cascade off the front edge and pay out, more falling coins paying a larger multiplier up to a sixteen-times jackpot on a full four-coin cascade, while a pile that stays below the threshold pays nothing. A drop debits one bounded play-token stake. Across all forty-eight equally likely shelf-and-push combinations the expected return is 0.9583, a house edge of about 4.17 percent. The shelf is simulated fresh from committed randomness each drop rather than persisted across rounds. Non-integer, non-positive, and over-limit stakes are rejected before any wallet movement.
requirements.notes: Allocated for GitHub issue #156, a catalog-expansion game (#73). The module supplies only pure rules; the shared core owns settlement. Issue #1007 delegates route, busy, locale, request-id, and external stylesheet ownership to the shared lifecycle without changing the machine, payout table, 700 ms cascade timing, settlement, DOM, or visible layout.

requirements.description: Coin Pusher inherits the shared core's exactly-once settlement: one caller-stable request id maps to one drop, a retry replays the identical committed shelf and payout without moving the wallet again, and a request id reused with different wager content fails closed. The additive v1 contract exposes only the game-owned state and drops routes and never alters the frozen shared API. Every drop commits its shelf fill and push, and the published catalog reports the honest threshold and cascade multipliers.
requirements.notes: Allocated for GitHub issue #156. Issue #1007 preserves the exact state and drops endpoints, caller-stable request payload, committed wager rendering, wallet refresh, reload recovery, and real repeat flow while removing duplicate frontend lifecycle helpers.
